about: The lab's two hatches open each in turn, as people pass through.

moves.name: hatch_door_leaf_1
moves.from: A pressure hatch opened by someone passing through, SCORE's own (the game opens a hatch only when the player presses it): swung 90 degrees into the room on the upright line through its hinge hatch_hinge_1, at 30 degrees a second (data/checks/motion.json hatch: a low-energy swing door's 18 to 27, a power door's at most 53), held open 8 s, shut again; each hatch of the room in its own turn of the 60 s round. Its wheel and window ride it.
